Malaysia
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
"Three days before the planned trip to Malaysia, it is necessary to fill out the digital arrival card for Malaysia – Malaysia Digital Personnel for Digital Arrival (MDAC), which can be found on the website: https://imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac/main.
Further information can be found on the Website of the Malaysian Immigration Service: www.imi.gov.my "
Citizens of Malaysia, holders of valid ordinary, diplomatic and official passports, shall be exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit ,transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days.
